messages:
emma_partnerships: Quick sync — AWS/GCP/Azure listing preflight. Need legal + product + eng to sign off on terms, packaging, and SKU mapping. Target public by 04/15. Any blockers?
alex_legal: I can take the publisher agreement addendum. @sam_product do we need extra DPA/data processing language for EU customers?
sam_product: Yes — EU customers require a residency note. Also planning two SKUs: Hosted API (pay-as-you-go) + Dedicated (reserved capacity). Need pricing bands and billing contact.
maria_engineering: Are we doing AMI images for the private option or just containers? If AMI, I need build artifacts, startup scripts, and expected instance types (e.g., g4, a10) for validation.
raj_ops: For Azure/GCP we'll need service principal permissions and entitlement mapping. I can spin up temp test accounts if you send contact emails.
zoe_pm: I'll open a packaging PR with the matrix (SKU, artifact type, pricing tier, region support). ETA tomorrow. Also: where are partner logos and trademark usage docs?
alex_legal: Not yet cleared. @emma_partnerships can you attach trademark cert and the approved trademark wording? Also may need to limit indemnity exposure in AWS terms — will flag redlines.
emma_partnerships: Uploading assets now. Quick checklist I'm using:
```
- Publisher account created
- Legal artifacts: COI, trademark cert, DPA
- Product assets: AMI/container, docs, screenshots
- Pricing + SKU mapping
- Entitlement & billing contact
```
marketplace-bot: Deploy check: publisher account status OK, 2FA missing for emma@redwood.com
emma_partnerships: @marketplace-bot ack — enabling 2FA now :white_check_mark:
maria_engineering: Posting startup script snippet for AMI option for visibility:
```#!/bin/bash
apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates jq
# start inference service
/opt/redwood/bin/start-server --model=redwood-v1 --user=redwood-run\```
Need confirmation on service user, ports, and healthcheck path.
sam_product: Ports: 443 + 5005. Service user: redwood-run. Healthcheck: /_health returns 200. Also add recommended instance sizes to docs.
raj_ops: I'll request vendor test accounts and add entitlement mapping note. Send emails + short test plan and I'll onboard.
zoe_pm: Got it — I'll collect logos, write trademark usage snippet, and fill publisher page fields. Target internal review by 04/05.
alex_legal: I'll deliver legal addendum + DPA redlines by 04/02. After we have product artifacts, let's do a final go/no-go sync 04/06.
emma_partnerships: Sounds good. Quick Q: AWS requires AMI copying to specified regions — any concerns on snapshot costs?
maria_engineering: We can automate AMI copy via pipeline but snapshot transfer + storage costs apply. Need budget approval. cc @raj_ops
raj_ops: Noted — I'll include snapshot+egress cost estimate in the ops ticket and tag finance.
emma_partnerships: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll post the asset links and a short test plan in the PR when ready. :thumbsup:
